title: Pulsed two-photon scattering from a single atom in a waveguide with delay-modified temporal correlations
summary: Quantum nonlinearity is an essential ingredient for many quantum technologies, but often the nonlinearity is too weak to be exploited at the few-photon level. However, few photons interacting strongly with single quantum emitters in a waveguide environment can impact a significant nonlinear response, opening up a wide range of photon-photon correlations. Using a waveguide-QED system containing a single atom (treated as a two-level system) chirally coupled to a waveguide, we theoretically investigate two-photon nonlinearities with delay-controlled temporal correlations.
